object_observations.note: No visible equation label on inspected course page; null is not a claim about every equation.

findings: CNX sample figures/examples use chapter-based counters; course samples use section-based counters.
The simple full-source counter experiment misnumbers the opening kinematics figure as 2.24 rather than 2.23, and its first equation as 2.27 rather than 2.23.
The simple full-source counter gives the ideal gas equation 9.5 rather than historical 9.1. Exact reset/exclusion rules need further evidence.
Course exercise pages are separate chapter views; this prototype deliberately leaves each canonical exercise in its source module. Exercise numbering is not validated.
PDF text extraction loses some visible course figure/example labels. Visual inspection is necessary.
